title: Engineering Compliance Officer
abstract: On the hunt for an Engineering Compliance Officer to join the City of Gold Coast!
content_text:
- Full Time | Permanent 
 - From $101,616.00 plus superannuation
 - Position Brief - Engineering Compliance Officer 
 About the team
 The Engineering, Design and Standards Branch is responsible for infrastructure engineering, design, survey, specifications, asset standards, electrical infrastructure and contributed assets across all customer and community facing infrastructure classes.
 About the role 
 We are seeking an Engineering Compliance Officer to provide specialist technical expertise in the assessment, approval, and compliance of water, recycled water, and wastewater infrastructure.
 Key responsibilities include:
 - Assess development applications and apply compliance conditions for water, recycled water, and wastewater services
 - Manage non-standard water and sewer connections, including live works, shutdowns, and bypass arrangements
 - Review and approve construction methodologies, QA documentation, commissioning, and As-Constructed data
 - Conduct site inspections and resolve design or construction conflicts to ensure compliance with approvals and standards
 - Provide technical input into standards, products, and best-practice outcomes, working collaboratively across teams
 We’re looking for people who have: 
 - Bachelor’s degree of Civil or Mechanical Engineering or equivalent knowledge
 - Substantial knowledge and/or experience in the design and construction of all facets of water and sewer assets
 - Substantial knowledge of the SEQ D&C Code and the requirements within
 - Knowledge and understanding of legislation and by-laws including: Workplace Health and Safety Act and relevant Code of Practice, Environmental Protection Act, Water Act 2000
 - Knowledge and understanding of the development planning and approval process, the conditions and their application
 - Knowledge and experience using quality management systems, including 9001, 14001, HACCP and 4801.
 - Demonstrates a high level of interpersonal, negotiation, oral and written communication skills including an ability to articulate complex issues in a changing environment. 
 - Ability to interpret and apply relevant legislation, policies and procedures
 - Ability to work productively in a team environment and to foster good relationships with other team members and all levels of management
 - Ability to engage with all users of water, recycled water and sewer networks in a positive manner
 - High level of technical expertise, with strong influencing, interpersonal and negotiation skills. 
 - Demonstrated ability to work in an office environment, on a construction site and in a customer’s premises. 
 - C Class Drivers Licence Unrestricted
 - General Construction Induction White Card
 Be part of shaping the Gold Coast’s future 
 The Gold Coast is inspired by lifestyle and driven by opportunity. We are the second largest Council in Australia. 
 We care about being the most flexible government organisation in Australia. We have a range of benefits to help you create the right balance: 
 - Flexible work arrangements to suit your lifestyle, including hybrid/work from home options, flexible working hours and locations 
 - Personal and professional development courses 
 - Access to 350+ fitness facilities through Fitness Passport 
 - 4 free confidential counselling sessions a year for you or an immediate family member 
 - 1 free nutritionist and financial advice session per year 
 We pride ourselves on our shared mission of being a high-performing, customer-focused organisation which delivers value-for-money services to the community. 
 How to apply
 To submit your application, please click apply now and complete the application form. You will be required to upload your resume and a cover letter (no more than two pages) outlining how your skills, experience and personal attributes will enable you to be successful in this role. Please note that you may also be asked to provide relevant qualifications, where applicable.
 Contact Person Alexandra McNulty 
Contact Email amcnulty@goldcoast.qld.gov.au 
Closing Date Monday, 26 October 2026 at 11:59pm AEDT 
 Our selection process may include a one-way video interview via Criteria, a face-to-face or virtual interview via Microsoft Teams, reference checks via Xref and additional checks including police checks, employment history checks, qualification checks, pre-employment medical reviews and drug and alcohol testing. 
 We’re committed to creating a diverse workplace and inclusive culture. We take pride in people who align with our high-performance principles. We believe that the diverse makeup of our workforce reflects the community we serve. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences and identities, and encourage candidates to discuss any support or adjustments they may need throughout the recruitment process.
